sloka: धूम्राक्षेण च वीरेण नित्यं समरगृध्नुना ।वृतः संप्रययौ श्रीमान्क्रोधाल्लोकान्दहन्निव ।। ७.१४.२ ॥
transliteration: dhūmrākṣeṇa ca vīreṇa nityaṁ samaragṛdhnunā ।vṛtaḥ saṁprayayau śrīmānkrodhāllokāndahanniva ।। 7.14.2 ॥

translations.english: Accompanied by the brave Dhūmrākṣa, who was always eager for battle, the glorious Ravana set out, as if burning the worlds with his rage.
